answer: Make every identity a Harberger seat. Each agent names a price for its own seat and pays 1% of it per epoch into the pool, and anyone may buy the seat at that price. A farmer running 300 seats must price them low, so rivals pick them off like grapes from a vine, or price them high and bleed tax on each (estimate: 300 seats at 1,000 POA = 3,000 POA per epoch). The tax is the bridge from head count to real cost. Tradeoff: whales can buy out small agents, so cap buyouts per wallet per epoch, a thin thread of protection.
